تستمعين (form VIII)
# تَسْتَمِعِينَ (tastamiʕīna) /tas.ta.mi.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# تُسْتَمَعِينَ (tustamaʕīna) /tus.ta.ma.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
